keys.title: Shapes Galore
keys.goal_caption: Tap the square that contains this shape:
keys.tutorial_goal_body: A shape is shown at the bottom of the screen. Your task: find the square on the board that contains exactly this shape.
keys.tutorial_board_body: The shape is hidden in one of the 24 squares. Here it is shown in gray and may be rotated, so look at the shape, not the color.
keys.tutorial_rotate_body: The picture may be rotated compared to the board. Tap the rotate button to turn it.
keys.tutorial_hint_body: Stuck? Tapping the light bulb reveals the colors, and a second tap marks the right square. Tap it once.
keys.tutorial_colors_body: Look: the shape below now shows its real colors, which makes it easier to find on the board. Tap the light bulb again to mark the right square.
keys.tutorial_try_body: The right square is marked with a dashed white frame. Tap it! Wrong taps count as attempts, and a correct tap takes you to the next level.
